newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nike EPS view cut.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said it trimmed its 1997 and 1998 earnings outlook on Nike Inc but maintained its strong buy rating.
-- Salomon analyst Brett Barakett trimmed the fiscal year 1997 earnings estimate to $2.67 a share from $2.83 a share and cut the fiscal 1998 estimate to $3.21 a share from $3.40 a share.

-- Earlier on Thursday, Nike said it expects earnings for the fourth quarter ending May 31 to be between $0.51 a share and $0.56 a share, below analysts' consensus estimate of $0.69 a share. Nike said the earnings will include a one-time, pre-tax charge equal to $0.04 a share.
